subjects.name: Oprah Winfrey Leadership Academy for Girls

summary: Life and influence of US talk-show host Oprah Winfrey, from a hard Mississippi childhood to a media empire that fed the Satanic Panic and other scares and gave New Age gurus, quacks and anti-vaccine voices a national platform.

evidence.note: birth in Kosciusko, Mississippi, in January 1954
account of a relative repeatedly molesting her as a child in Milwaukee
1984 move to Chicago to host the morning show that became her own program
satanic ritual abuse episode framed as blood libel on national TV
mid-1990s pivot to spiritual content with Marianne Williamson
Deepak Chopra segment on mind-over-body health claims
mad cow episode and the beef industry lawsuit against her
rainbow party panic introduced on the show
her girls' school in South Africa and its abuse scandal
post-2010 Haiti orphanage boom and child-trafficking case
James Arthur Ray, promoted on her show, and his deadly sweat lodge
Jenny McCarthy's anti-vaccine appearances boosted by the show

notes: Primary theme entertainment-celebrity chosen over propaganda-media since the story is about a TV talk-show empire. Diet culture (wagon of fat) folded into wellness-self-help. Haiti segment is partly about the broader orphanage industry rather than Oprah directly. main_span starts with the 1984 Chicago show; end null as she is alive and still active.
